hypothesis:
Mechanism: Swap-Equivariant Minimax Dual Coupler (SE-MDC) augments CR-FPL with a symmetric two-side attention step whose shared dual slack tokens estimate relative endpoint risk and jointly allocate each loop's convex log-distance update, trained by a smooth object-level worst-side saddle objective.
Hypothesis: CR-FPL's independent shared-side loops optimize the mean but cannot move correction capacity toward the harder endpoint, causing p99 regressions despite convergent residuals; a permutation-equivariant minimax dual lets the two sides compete through relative evidence without introducing side identities or handcrafted thresholds.
Observable: On the unchanged Articraft 13/6 and NJC 11/4 source gates, four-loop SE-MDC preserves CR-FPL's mean gain while lowering worst-side NMAE and target-relative p99 versus CR-FPL and its own same-parameter one-loop output; swap error remains <=1e-6 and loop residuals remain decreasing.
Conflicts: Validated [8.16] proves local re-query and fixed-point convergence but shows Articraft worst-side and both-domain p99 tail regressions; this node changes cross-side credit allocation rather than loop count, width, seed, thresholds, or data splits, and avoids the marginal-transport tail failures of pruned [8.11]-[8.13].
insight: SE-MDC validates exact swap-equivariant coupled recurrent mechanics and strong tail suppression, but does not improve the primary mean on both source domains. On Articraft minimax, coupled reaches mean/worst 0.209117/0.225900 versus CR-FPL-minimax 0.192426/0.221139 and equal-parameter independent 0.225819/0.226559, while reducing max-side target-relative p99 to 1.233417 versus 1.447152/1.262213. On NJC minimax, coupled improves object-macro mean/worst to 0.269822/0.269826 versus CR-FPL-minimax 0.295630/0.295631 and independent 0.303314/0.303314, but remains worse than frozen CR-FPL original 0.245383 and has p99 2.145510 versus independent 1.593402. The minimax loss clips gradients on 97.6-99.8% of steps, so its optimization geometry, not insufficient loop contraction, is the limiting factor.
result: PARTIAL/PRUNE_AS_PRIMARY: fixed 3-architecture x 2-loss x 2-domain matrix completed at commit d5938d094755a2fb229833f5b57d9ad812a404b3. Structural gate fails because coupled-minimax does not beat CR-FPL-minimax in Articraft mean/worst and does not beat frozen CR-FPL-original NJC macro mean. Positive evidence: exact swap error <=7.99e-15; every coupled loop prediction residual decreases over four iterations; coupled beats equal-parameter independent on mean/worst in both domains and improves several tails. Next branch should preserve the coupled block but replace the saturating hard minimax training objective with a scale-adaptive constrained allocation/update rule, without weight/seed tuning.
